moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio hover-lift, written here): Card (about half the frame) at rest; when the cursor lands (20 % of a 1.6 s loop) it lifts y −7 px, scale 1 → 1.02, shadow 0 8 18 α .28 → 0 20 34 α .46 in 180 ms power2.out; holds to 70 %; returns the same way by 81 %. Cursor fades in 58 px right / 40 px below centre, reaches the card centre at 19 %, leaves at 70-80 %. Params: lift (7 px) · scale (1.02) · duration (0.18 s) · hold (0.6 s) · ease (power2.out).
